entries.reason: Current paintScreenDrops still calls o.pos.clone() per drop, then hit.point.clone() or from.clone() for its projected point. The per-sheet pair of independent projection vectors is absent. Other screen movement scratch or flight-kind changes are separate.

All three specified wrappers still use rest forwarding: weapon-gates Actor.update(dt,...args), Projectiles._new(...args), and splatling Actor._horizontal(dt,squid,onEnemy,...rest). No fixed-count call/arguments fallback is present. Unrelated fixed-arity wrappers do not implement this row.
